Content: The thing is, it’s all more ephemeral than we think, this online-offline world. For example, when I note that she doesn’t appear to own a TV, Seu reveals that she’s kind of against streaming. “I’m a big downloader, because I feel like it’s a way of storing, like a grassroots way of saving what you want to be preserved,” she says. “Owning your content instead of just assuming it’ll be in the cloud forever—it really won’t.” -
